scope: Explicit legacy OET/ADL 1.4 compilation profile, independent OPT 1.4 schema/RM structure, preserved source constraints and atomic DRAFT build evidence; not complete AOM semantics or hosted Designer interchange
preservation_cases: Exact original node identifiers and input hashes
English/German term definitions and typed system/version/code bindings
Original quantity bounds and ordinal assumptions
Explicit temporal assumptions, no parser-derived singleton defaults
Narrowing rules, annotated model paths and recorded optional-slot exclusions
Repeated source/dependency order produces byte-identical XML
UTF-8 BOM parsed without changing the original source hash
negative_cases: Incompatible or ambiguous slots and paths
Invalid value assumptions and reversed temporal ranges
Unsupported constructs and unknown namespaces/placement kinds
Large escaped XML JSON and duplicate-key aliases
